blocks.text: Garden obelisk trellis with Stone Coated - A durable, stunning addition to any landscape!Our garden trellis steel adds a special decorative element to your garden and indoor plant trellis, ideal for climbing plant support, flowering, vegetable, and plant vines like clematis, climbing roses, tomato plants, dragon fruit, and passion fruit vines.The garden obelisk for climbing plants is made from solid steel pipe supports up to 20 pounds. 3 layers of black matte coating with stone texture to resist weather and rust. This trellis for potted plants obelisk uses a unique technology consisting of a stable ring joint with a compact connection that is easy to put together without screws. Strong insert end caps of our plant tower can be pushed straight into the ground.Steel obelisk trellis details:Design: Ergonomic design ensures your plant grows easilyMaterial: Steel Pipe with Stone CoatedColor: BlackSize: 72 7/16'' x 13 7/8"

items.label: STURDY VERTICAL SUPPORT FOR PLANTS
items.value: Durable steel with a stone-coated finish, our trellis for climbing plants indoor supports roses, vines, and vegetables; Dimensions: 71 in H x 13 in W, ideal as a garden trellis

items.label: ELEGANT OBELISK DESIGN
items.value: Our decorative plant trellis enhances outdoor spaces and interiors, adding sophistication while supporting climbing plants; As an indoor plant trellis, the design elevates houseplants and provides structure for growth

items.label: WEATHERPROOF AND DURABLE
items.value: Our garden trellis for climbing plants is crafted with rustproof components and a stone-coated finish, ensuring durability across seasons. The obelisk trellis design provides both practical support and visual appeal

items.label: SPACE-SAVING FOR SMALL GARDENS
items.value: The vertical design maximizes space, ideal for small outdoor areas; Our metal trellis supports upward plant growth and also serves as a plant trellis for climbing plants indoor, enhancing interiors

items.label: EASY TO ASSEMBLE AND VERSATILE USE
items.value: Simple setup for garden beds, pots, or landscaping; Our garden obelisk supports climbing plants like clematis, jasmine, or beans; Weighing just 5 pounds, the house plant trellis is lightweight and portable
